notes.title: Morbid Update: Alpha 3
notes.notes:
Alpha 3 has been pushed to the main branch. This update includes bug fixes, working Steam Achievements, and some performance improvements.

[list]
[*] A few changes have been made to the storyline.
[*] Subtitles have been added to give more context to the game and improve playability.
[*] The item spawning system is currently being updated and should be included in Alpha 4.
[/list]

More information can be found on the [url=https://github.com/orgs/Morbid-Software/projects/1/views/1]Morbid Development Tracker[/url].

notes.title: Morbid Update: Alpha 2
notes.notes:
This is just a quick announcement that Alpha 2 has been pushed to the main branch. Players will see a new menu system, some bug fixes, and a few gameplay changes.

There is also now a launch option to choose between DirectX 11 or 12.
